finalText:
Done. Out of 380 commits, only 28 actually change behavior — one feature and 27 fixes — everything else (dep bumps, refactors, CI/test churn) is noise. A few things worth flagging before you publish:

**The one thing I'd double-check myself:** the auth status-code change (401 instead of 403 for expired tokens). I put it under Breaking rather than Fixed because anyone whose client branches on 403 will silently break on upgrade — but you know if that's actually a documented/relied-upon status code for this API. Worth a second look.

**Dedup note:** several fixes appear 2-4 times in the commit log with identical messages across different modules (e.g. "guard the null cursor in the paginator" hit queue, api, webhooks, and db separately; "drop the duplicate header" hit core three separate times). I collapsed these into one changelog line each, naming all affected modules, rather than listing every commit — that's almost certainly what happened (same bug pattern copy-pasted across modules) rather than a fix regressing and being reapplied, but I can't verify that from the log alone.

**Left out:** a handful of `perf(...)` commits (batching metric writes, skipping a JSON round-trip, avoiding a clone) — no benchmarks in the log to back a real "faster now" claim, so I didn't want to promise something I couldn't quantify. Say the word if you want them added anyway.

The CHANGELOG.md now has the 4.2.0 section in place, dated for tomorrow's cut.
